Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.mail

Class ImapSmtpMailService

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.mail.ImapSmtpMailService
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, MailService
public class ImapSmtpMailService extends Object implements MailService
The real MailService: IMAP for reading folders / messages and SMTP for sending, on Jakarta Mail 2.x (the Eclipse Angus provider). One instance is bound to one MailAccount by connect(MailAccount, String).

Design notes for the plan's non-functional goals:

  • Fast - listing fetches only headers (FetchProfile.Item.ENVELOPE/FLAGS/CONTENT_INFO) so a big folder is cheap to show; bodies and attachment bytes are pulled lazily on open(org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.mail.MailMessage)/openAttachment(org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.mail.MailMessage, org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.mail.MailAttachment).
  • Secure - TLS by default (SSL or STARTTLS); certificate validation is left on (no ssl.trust=* wildcard); plaintext is only used when the account explicitly selects MailAccount.Security.NONE.
  • Reliable - explicit connect/read/write timeouts so a dead server fails fast instead of hanging the caller.
